label: August 3–9, 2026
intro: Post-holiday calm before BICT Fest storm — the quietest queues at Marvel all month, and Toob North still cooking at Cloud 11. A great week to finally do the Iron Man trip.
weekday_note: Weekday Sub-Zero sessions (100 THB kids) are near-empty in August — great for ice practice without the crowd.

activities.title: The Marvel Experience Thailand
activities.date: Saturday or Sunday — book on Klook
activities.location: Mega Bangna (BTS On Nut + Grab, ~30 min)
activities.why: Iron Man's Stark Mobile Lab, 4D stereoscopic dome, VR flight training, and character meet-and-greets with Iron Man, Thor the Avenger, Spider-Man, and Hulk. Post-holiday August week means shorter queues than usual. If you're going once this summer, now's the time.
activities.tip: Book Klook tickets in advance. Arrive 15 mins early, catch the first dome session. Allow 2 hours minimum.

activities.title: Toob North at theCOMMONS Cloud 11
activities.date: Through August 30 — weekends and select weekdays
activities.price: Free to browse; workshop sessions priced individually
activities.why: The northern Thai makers market is still in full swing. Watch live pottery, try a hands-on clay or weaving session, eat northern food. Exactly the kind of building & making outing Thor loves — and August is quieter than the holiday rush.
activities.tip: August weekday sessions are more personal — makers have more time to engage with curious 5-year-olds.

activities.title: Roller Dome Emporium — Weekend Session
activities.location: Roller Dome, Emporium Mall, Sukhumvit Soi 24
activities.why: Regular rollerblading practice — each visit builds Thor's confidence and technique. Coaches available if he wants to work on a specific skill. Post-holiday August weekends are less crowded.
activities.tip: Sunday morning 10–11am is consistently the quietest slot.

activities.title: Sub-Zero Ice Skating — Weekday Session
activities.location: Sub-Zero Ice Skate Club, Major Cineplex Sukhumvit (Ekkamai BTS, skywalk)
activities.price: 100 THB kids / 200 THB adults + skate rental
activities.why: August weekday afternoons at Sub-Zero are blissfully quiet. Two dedicated rinks: Arena Rink (fun skating) and Academy Rink (coaching). Great for building ice confidence at Thor's own pace.
activities.tip: Book a 1-hour lesson (900 THB) if Thor wants to level up — the coaches are patient with young beginners.

activities.title: Kad Kokoa Kids Bonbon Chocolate Workshop
activities.price: Check website for current session price
activities.why: Monthly kids bonbon-making sessions in small groups. Thor gets to make and take home real Thai craft chocolate. Book the August slot this week before it fills.
activities.tip: Follow Kad Kokoa on LINE Official to get notified the moment August dates go live.

activities.title: 🎭 Coming Up: BICT Fest — Bangkok Children's Theatre Festival
activities.location: One Bangkok Park + Goethe-Institut Thailand + Sodsai Centre (Chulalongkorn Univ.)
activities.price: Free programmes available + ticketed shows (check eventpop.me/c/bictfest2026)
activities.why: 10th anniversary BICT Fest: 11 interactive performances from 9 countries (South Korea, Japan, Taiwan, Belgium, France, UK, Singapore, Indonesia, Thailand). Theme: 'Play Attention: Look Who's Growing Up!' Shows are participatory — kids interact alongside artists. Designed for babies through teens.
activities.tip: Free programme slots open early and disappear fast. Check bictfest.com this week and grab your tickets now — don't wait until Aug 21.
